description: Adversarial/harder supplementary set spanning all 5 test_papers/ PDFs, built specifically to differentiate retrieval methods (the verified golden set is curated to only include questions that already work with cosine, so it can't show accuracy differences between methods). Includes cases verified to genuinely MISS with plain MiniLM+cosine as of this benchmark run.
